question: For the year 2012, which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group? Please include the evaluation group, evaluation type, condition status code, evaluation description, state code, macroplot acres, and subplot acres.
sql:
WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * p.expansion_factor * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) AS total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * p.expansion_factor * c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) AS total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
    AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    AND p.survey_unit_code = c.survey_unit_code
    AND p.county_code = c.county_code
    AND p.phase_2_plot_number = c.phase_2_plot_number
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    total_macroplot_acres AS macroplot_acres,
    total_subplot_acres AS subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  macroplot_acres,
  subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
